headline: S187 fixes paused ability recharge, speed-pickup stat corruption, ignored reload preference and missing startup sync.
shipped: Recipient startup sync and five compatible libraries are restored. Four tests prove local remote pull, script-root identity, WIP preservation and conflict detection; executable ASTs match the canonical source.
Dash and grenade recharge on active simulation frames. Frozen-state tests, exact durations, modifiers, instant readiness grants and run isolation pass; wall-clock callbacks are removed.
Speed pickups use independent 300-active-frame durations and an additive movement bonus. Expiry preserves permanent base stats, stacked pickups and speed caps without mutating a rematch.

Empty-magazine automatic reload honors the saved preference. Actual-App tests and desktop/mobile browser checks preserve manual reload and automatic reload; the forced Overclocked reload test also passes.
validation: S187 source 40e619d78bc72939366613ce754f8689d508ce4f passed exact-main workflow 39144720337: 296/296 test files, 1,988/1,988 assertions, strict lint, configured build and Cloudflare deployment. Canonical callofdoodie.wtf reports 40e619d78bc7; canonical and immutable https://73a5ea19.call-of-doodie.pages.dev pass shell 7/7 each. Four real-browser cooldown cases pass at 390/1440 in both themes; two desktop/mobile speed and manual/automatic reload cases also pass.
limits: FORGE/public-unlaunched unchanged. Physical controllers, participant comparisons and target-device/model-token measurements remain unmeasured. Existing permanent-speed/Kill Frenzy composition is outside this pickup-expiry repair. Browser input and speed/ammo fixtures are assisted; no natural full-run claim.
